lines.text: To be honest, I liked the first one.

data.define: Used before saying your real opinion.

example.text: To be honest, I liked the first one.

misuse.text: Don't say 'to be honest' before every sentence.
misuse.why: It makes other sentences sound untrue.

publish.title: What does "to be honest" mean?
publish.value: To be honest = I'll tell you the truth. Example: "To be honest, I liked the first one." (casual English).
